matchstick.title: Transform V into X by repositioning one stick
matchstick.principle: If a V (two diagonal sticks) appears, moving one of its diagonal sticks to intersect the other creates an X. Ensure both source and target symbols remain valid after the move.
matchstick.when_to_apply: When a V is present and converting it to X could help balance the equation.
matchstick.example: Removing a diagonal stick from V and leaving a single diagonal stick (invalid numeral).

matchstick.title: Move a vertical I‑stick between numerals
matchstick.principle: A vertical I‑stick can be detached from a numeral containing I's and attached to another numeral, provided both remain valid Roman numerals.
matchstick.when_to_apply: When adjusting numeral values by transferring a single I stick could help balance the equation.
matchstick.example: Detaching a vertical stick from an I and leaving an empty symbol (invalid numeral).

matchstick.title: Prefer intra‑character stick relocation
matchstick.principle: First explore relocating a stick within the same character, as this often yields a valid transformation without affecting other symbols.
matchstick.when_to_apply: At the start of solving, try moving a stick inside a single numeral or operator before considering inter‑character moves.
matchstick.example: Moving a stick from a numeral to another numeral without checking that the source remains a valid numeral.

matchstick.title: Validate source and target symbols after a stick move
matchstick.principle: After moving a stick, both the symbol you removed it from and the symbol you added it to must remain valid Roman numerals or operators.
matchstick.when_to_apply: After any stick relocation, verify that the resulting symbols are still valid.
matchstick.example: Moving a horizontal stick from the '=' sign to a numeral, leaving the '=' as a single horizontal line (invalid) and creating an invalid numeral.

matchstick.title: Avoid creating single angled sticks (invalid numerals)
matchstick.principle: A lone diagonal stick does not correspond to any Roman numeral; V and X require two diagonal sticks.
matchstick.when_to_apply: When moving diagonal sticks, ensure you do not leave a single diagonal stick.
matchstick.example: Removing one diagonal from V, leaving a single diagonal stick (invalid numeral).

matchstick.title: Convert + to - by moving its vertical stick
matchstick.principle: If a plus sign is present, removing its vertical stick turns it into a minus sign; the removed stick can be used elsewhere.
matchstick.when_to_apply: When a plus sign appears and changing it to minus could help balance the equation.
matchstick.example: Removing the vertical stick from + and leaving a stray vertical stick unattached.

matchstick.title: Create a new numeral by moving a stick to a new position (reordering)
matchstick.principle: A stick can be detached from an existing numeral and placed at a new location, forming a new numeral.
matchstick.when_to_apply: When the equation can be balanced by creating a new numeral from an existing stick.
matchstick.example: Moving a stick from a numeral to a blank space, creating an invalid symbol.

matchstick.title: Consider inter‑character stick relocation when intra‑character moves fail
matchstick.principle: If no intra‑character stick move yields a valid equality, explore moving a stick from one character to another.
matchstick.when_to_apply: After exhausting intra‑character moves without success.
matchstick.example: Moving a stick from one numeral to another, leaving the source numeral invalid.

matchstick.title: Swap operators via horizontal stick move
matchstick.principle: If the equation contains both an '=' sign (two horizontal sticks) and a '-' or '+' sign (single horizontal stick), moving one horizontal stick from the '=' to the '-' (or vice versa) swaps the operators while keeping both valid. This can correct the equality without altering numerals.
matchstick.when_to_apply: When the equation includes both an equality sign and a subtraction or addition sign, and the arithmetic is off by a simple operator change.
matchstick.example: Moving a horizontal stick from the '=' sign to a numeral, leaving the '=' as a single horizontal line (invalid) and creating an invalid numeral.
